title: Generate light-theme MAL logo asset
description: Create a light-theme version of the MAL logo/lockup that matches the existing Mobile Architecture Lab branding assets and can be used in the static site.

functional_requirements.heading: Light-theme logo asset
functional_requirements.body: Add a logo asset under the existing logo directory that is legible on light backgrounds and consistent with the current MAL visual identity.

functional_requirements.heading: Site compatibility
functional_requirements.body: Use a browser-friendly asset format and preserve existing logo assets without breaking current pages.

non_functional_requirements.heading: Scoped visual change
non_functional_requirements.body: Keep the work limited to logo assets and any minimal references needed for discoverability.

acceptance_criteria.heading: Asset exists
acceptance_criteria.body: A light-theme MAL logo asset exists on disk in the repo with valid SVG or image structure.

acceptance_criteria.heading: Visual validation
acceptance_criteria.body: The asset can be rendered locally and inspected for light-background contrast and correct framing.

out_of_scope.heading: No full redesign
out_of_scope.body: Do not redesign landing, sponsor deck, or invoice pages.

out_of_scope.heading: No unrelated content changes
out_of_scope.body: Do not alter speaker, sponsor, or event copy.
